name: Lu Raise
instructions: Set up for the Lu Raise with a barbell. Get into a stable position with your core braced.
Press the weight away from your body with control, keeping your wrists stacked and your ribs down.
Lower back to the start under control. Keep tension through the whole range — do not drop or bounce.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: Lu Raise is a intermediate other exercise for the front delts and middle delts, performed with a barbell.
